## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Salesforce **write-path** changes state how they were verified
      (unit tests with mocked boundaries, and/or a real-org run per
      [`docs/release-validation.md`](../docs/release-validation.md))
- [ ] User-facing changes update the relevant docs (`README.md`,
      `CHANGELOG.md`, or `docs/`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, org identifiers, or customer data in code, tests,
      fixtures, or screenshots
